preconditions.description: root is a valid Binary Tree node

postconditions.description: the function returns the head of the doubly linked list

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, DoublyLinkedListNode) for node in traverse_tree_inorder(root))
postconditions.description: the inorder traversal of the modified tree does not contain any leaf nodes
the doubly linked list from left to right contains all the leaf nodes of the original tree in the same order
the doubly linked list from right to left contains all the leaf nodes of the original tree in the same order

invariants.expression: all(node.left is None and node.right is None for node in extract_leaf_nodes(root))
invariants.description: all leaf nodes are removed from the tree
